description: A 4x4 Junon grassland valley with a road along the valley floor from the west exit to the east exit. Cliffs line both sides, and the clifftops are wide walkable ledges reached by a ramp at each end of the valley. A path runs along the northern clifftop past a lookout tower, and players on the ledges can see the road below but cannot drop down except at the ramps.
notes: Cliffs: 12 m at 72 degrees; ledges 38 m wide, part of the play area, the mountains rise behind them.
Ramps: 22 degrees along the cliff foot, one at each end of each ledge (four).
'Cannot drop down except at the ramps': invisible walls (IFO collision boxes, as retail uses) along the ledge edge, open at the ramps.
Lookout tower: guardpost01 (Junon decoration 200), in the middle of the north ledge.
name: Mapgen Highground
